scheme_name: Harvesting Tools Assistance for General Category (HRT-2)
other_conditions: Assistance is available only once in five years.
Equipment must be certified by ISO/BIS/ISI/Government recognized organizations and purchased through an authorized dealer or imported.
Unit cost of the harvesting tool should not exceed ₹2,00,000.
Beneficiary can be an individual farmer or an FPO/FPC/FIG/SHG/Co‑operative society.
benefits_summary: General Category farmers receive up to 50% of the tool cost or ₹1,00,000 (whichever is lower); FPO/FPC/FIG/SHG/Co‑operative societies receive up to 75% of the tool cost or ₹1,50,000 (whichever is lower), with a maximum tool price of ₹2,00,000.
